notes: Inspired by @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal difficulty. Duty Bound returns (again) still as an adaptive auto rifle which as a subfamily are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic as one of the largely interchangeable auto rifle families. The frame intrinsic offers no bonuses beyond "being well-rounded and reliable" as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are decent by comparison with its peers - you can see at https://d2foundry.gg/w/260532765 how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. The recoil is loose and to the right, so to tighten that up, look for a barrel perk that helps with Recoil Direction, and then with the magazine perk go for something that helps improve magazine size or reload. For clearing groups of adds in general content, Fourth Time's the Charm in the first trait perk column generates 2 shots from thin air after 4 crits within 2s (3s when enhanced) of each other to help keep uptime on Onslaught which, while it doesn't increase total damage per magazine, as you ramp up to the maximum 3 stacks does increase raw DPS for a refreshable 4.5s per kill (5s enhanced), by increasing RPM from 600 to a max of around 960. Alternatively, the reworked Rampage stacks up to ×3 on kills for ×1.331 damage for a refreshable 4.5s (5s when enhanced), with the stacks now decaying one at a time. You've got a choice of origin traits. You might be lucky and get the rare Accelerated Assault origin trait, which passively refills 10% of the magazine, and boosts damage by ×1.05 for getting 3 hits within a 1.6s window. Otherwise there's Problem Solver, which is very good for PvE when facing yellow bars - 12 hits will apply Exhaust to an enemy, reducing damage output to ×0.9 for a refreshable 5s and grant +50 to Reload Speed and Handling for 10s (12s enhanced) - both effects are also refreshable. There's also Vanguard Vindication which provides up to ×3 stacks on kills within 20s of using a class ability that reduces incoming damage to a max ×0.94 for a refreshable 10s (12.5s enhanced). Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

SpaceMonkey (PvE): "This is mostly pretty underwhelming. This weapon is pretty well-supported by the artifact this season but I still just don't see it being better than many weapons it is competing against. Adhesive Ordnance is nifty at least." Recommended MW: Reload, Range, Handling.
Chevy's S17 Super Pog PVE List Reload MW tags:pve, M+KB

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "With triple tap, fourth time’s the charm, and actium war rig, you could fire forever. In most cases that is entirely a meme, but against specific bosses it could be useful to have. A more utilitarian roll would be triple tap with vorpal weapon to slot in adept big ones when the grandmaster nightfalls release. Ideally you want to bring up the recoil direction from the base 60, but chambered compensator or extended barrel won’t do as much, and you won’t want to slot a counterbalance mod in favor of any of the spec mods. Arrowhead then becomes the only choice to really improve that recoil to something more desirable. Other options are then just to make the gun feel better. Stats for all pairs really well with one for all, but also fourth time’s the charm or vorpal for a better feeling gun. And perpetual motion will elevate the gun feel without needing to shoot.". Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "In the crucible there isn’t as much to talk about. perpetual motion or steady hands will enhance your loadout and dynamic sway reduction will help keep your bullets on target. The adaptive frame autos haven’t been extremely meta since their adjustment, but the likes of gnawing hunger or summoner will do a better job.". Recommended MW - Range or Handling.

Inspired by DMB Player Versus Enemies Podcast 11. PvE first choice roll for end-game content. Not too much to offer over other kinetic adaptive auto-rifles like Scathelocke or The Last Breath. Recoil Direction and stability both need some attention, so Arrowhead Brake and a stability mag perk help. The "All for All" pairing works well to both boost useful stats and damage. Recommended MW: Stability, with a Backup Mag or damage-boosting (Minor, Major, or Taken Spec) mod.

[YeezyGT's WQ] [Arrowhead / Counterbalance recommended] [MW: Range / Stability] "Duty Bound is another 600RPM Kinetic with very little fat in the perk pool - some great perks in Frenzy/Vorpal/Rampage/One-for-All, an Origin Trait similar to a bonus Unrelenting, and some consistency options in Perpetual/Zen Moment. The recoil does not feel great on console at all - I'd spec heavily into stability and recoil direction." tags:pve
